verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw has a dedicated Intellectual Property practice page that covers trademarks "from strategy and registration to enforcement," so registration and brand enforcement are documented as part of its own practice. However, the page combines trademarks with patents rather than describing a separate trademark team, and trademark clearance is not named explicitly. missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance/search services, a distinct trademark or brand-protection team, detail on enforcement scope (oppositions, litigation, anti-counterfeiting), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: from strategy and registration to enforcement
